title: Motor current correct
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (1) must be 1.5 A.

title: Motor output power correct
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (2) must be 3.375 W.

title: Bulb current from rating
description: Important: The solution correctly uses the bulb's normal operating power and voltage (P=4.5W, U=3V) to find the circuit current.

title: Apply loop rule
description: Important: The solution applies Kirchhoff's voltage law to find the voltage across the motor, accounting for the supply EMF, internal resistance drop, and bulb voltage.

title: Motor power balance
description: Important: The solution calculates the motor's output power correctly as the difference between its electrical input power (UI) and its resistive heating loss (I²R).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All calculations maintain consistent units (Volts, Amps, Ohms, Watts).

title: Misinterpret bulb rating
description: Pitfall: Using the bulb's power or voltage incorrectly (e.g., using P=U²/R without the correct current) to find the circuit current.

title: Sign or term error in KVL
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly summing voltage rises/drops in the loop rule, omitting a term or using the wrong sign.

title: Confuse motor power forms
description: Pitfall: Stating the motor's output power as simply UI or I²R, confusing input, output, or thermal power.
